plugins.name: rad-council
plugins.description:
A council of cognitive-framework advisors that debates any decision â repo plans, website/UX designs, product or codebase critiques, marketing plans, strategy choices â then votes and returns one ranked, confidence-rated recommendation with dissent preserved and a single concrete next step. Diversity comes from incompatible *reasoning lenses* (The Contrarian, First Principles, The Vulcan, The Metric, The Storyteller, The Outsider, The Executor, The Orator, The Expansionist, The Growth Catalyst), not personas â research shows frameworks beat roleplay and that perspective diversity, not debate depth, drives quality.

One `convene` skill with two modes: standard (independent drafts â one blind peer-review round + dot-vote â rigor-weighted synthesis) and quick (parallel critics â synthesis). A Blue Hat orchestrator auto-selects 3â5 seats for any topic by engineering natural tension between opposing lenses (hard cap 5, scaled to stakes). Synthesis weights by empirical rigor and logical consistency â never headcount â preserves genuine clashes, rates confidence 1â10, and commits to exactly one next step (disagree-and-commit). Two agents: `council-advisor` (parametrized seat, JSON-first) and `council-chair` (fresh-context synthesizer).

Guardrails are baked in against the documented failure modes of multi-agent debate: conformity drift (independent generation), sycophancy (framework constraints, not personas), false consensus (preserved dissent), and runaway cost (hard agent/round caps + effort scaling). Claude-only â no external API keys. Output is one self-contained markdown report, delivered where you choose, never auto-committed. Pairs with rad-brainstormer (diverge â converge) and rad-planner (decide â sequence); recommends rad-code-review for deep code passes rather than duplicating it.
plugins.author: RAD

plugins.name: rad-okf
plugins.description: Build and maintain Open Knowledge Format (OKF) knowledge bases â directories of markdown + YAML frontmatter readable by humans and any AI agent, with no SDK or server. Dependency-free stdlib Python 3 engine that never overwrites your files without a preview. Nine commands plus an always-on `okf` conventions skill: `start` (guided onboarding), `new` (scaffold a concept or whole bundle), `add` (import existing markdown), `convert` (turn .txt/.html/.csv/.json â or agent-extracted PDF/docx â into one conformant concept), `move` (link-safe rename/relocate that rewrites inbound links bundle-wide), `check` (validate frontmatter + required `type`, broken cross-links, orphaned and stale concepts, index drift â with a preview-gated `--fix`), `map` (self-contained zero-dependency HTML graph), `find` (ranked search by text/type/tag/status with related concepts), and `scan` (triage a repo or notes folder for importable knowledge, confirmation-gated). The engine owns `index.md`/`log.md`; every write previews first and is never destructive. Sync-agnostic: manage the knowledge here, sync the folder however you like (git, cloud folder, Obsidian, Syncthing).
